lines.japanese: 何、を…
lines.english: What… was I…

lines.japanese:
今、何をしようとした、俺？
何をしようとしたんだよ！？
lines.english: What was I about to do? What the hell was I about to do!?

lines.japanese:
さっきまで雪菜と一緒にいたのに。
ずっと、お互いのことを想っていたのに。
lines.english: I'd been with Setsuna only moments ago. We'd spent all that time thinking of each other.

lines.japanese: なのに今、俺が選んだ電話番号は…
lines.english: And yet the number I’d chosen was…

lines.japanese:
『春希のお望みのあたしが相手するよ？
親友でも、悪友でも…それとも…』
lines.english: “I’ll be whatever you want me to be, Haruki—your best friend, your partner in crime… or…”

lines.japanese:
俺にとって、
あまりに都合の良すぎる逃げ場をくれるって言った、
あいつのところだった。
lines.english: Hers—the girl who had offered me an escape so perfectly, obscenely convenient for me.

lines.japanese: あいつこそ、今、一番選んだらいけない相手。
lines.english: She was the one person I mustn't choose now.

lines.japanese:
雪菜にだけじゃなく、
あいつにとっても、酷すぎる選択だってのに。
lines.english: It would be unforgivably cruel—not just to Setsuna, but to her too.

lines.japanese:
「３番線最終電車、間もなく発車します。
ドアが閉まります、ご注意ください」
lines.english: “The last train on platform three will be departing shortly. Please stand clear of the closing doors.”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
なんとか、最後の意志を振り絞って、
電車に乗り込んだ。
lines.english: I scraped together the last of my resolve and boarded the train.

lines.japanese:
あいつの住む場所から遠ざかり、
俺の住む場所へと近づく『正しい』行き先の。
lines.english: The train was bound in the “right” direction—away from where she lived and toward my own home.

lines.japanese:
だから電車は、逃げ道じゃなく、帰り道を滑り、
ゆっくりと、白い景色を後ろに流していく。
lines.english: So it carried me home instead of toward escape, the white world sliding slowly away behind it.

lines.japanese:
けれど俺は、窓の外から目をそらし、
車内でのマナーも忘れ、携帯を開き、
その待ち受け画面をずっと見つめる。
lines.english: But I turned from the window, forgot every rule of train etiquette, flipped open my phone, and stared at the screen.

lines.japanese:
デフォルトのままの無機質な背景に、
満タンの電池残量、三本立ったアンテナ。
lines.english: The same sterile default wallpaper. A full battery. Three bars of reception.

lines.japanese:
何度見ても何の変哲もない、
何も見るべきところのない、ただの…
lines.english: No matter how often I looked, it was utterly unremarkable. There was nothing there worth looking at. Just…

lines.japanese:
なのに、閉じられない。
心がざわついたまま、画面から目を離せない。
lines.english: And yet I couldn't close it. My heart still churning, I couldn't look away from the screen.

lines.japanese:
自分でもそうする理由がわからな…
いや、そんなの嘘だ。
lines.english: I didn’t even know why I was doing it… No. That was a lie.

lines.japanese: 着信画面に変わるのを待ってるんだ、俺…
lines.english: I was waiting for it to change to an incoming-call screen…

lines.japanese:
あいつがコールバックしてくれるかもって、
そんな女々しくて最低なこと考えてるんだ、俺。
lines.english: I was hoping she might call me back. God, I was spineless. Despicable.

lines.japanese: 結局、電車が動いてくれたのは御宿までだった。
lines.english: In the end, the train only took me as far as Onjuku.

lines.japanese:
そこからタクシーでマンションまで戻った頃、
やみかけていた粉雪が、また徐々に力を取り戻し、
優しく、降りてくる。
lines.english: By the time a taxi brought me back to my building, the fine snow that had nearly stopped was gathering strength again, drifting gently down.

lines.japanese:
夜中の１時を大幅に過ぎて、
そろそろ２時になろうかという時間帯。
lines.english: It was well past one in the morning, and closing in on two.

lines.japanese: 気温の方は、肌を刺すまでに下がっていた。
lines.english: The cold had sharpened enough to sting bare skin.

lines.japanese:
クリスマスで賑わっていた御宿とは対照的に、
ここ南末次は、もう寝静まり。
lines.english: Unlike Onjuku, still lively with Christmas crowds, Minami-Suetsugu had long since gone to sleep.

lines.japanese:
そんな、静まり返った我が家の前で、
そっと深夜の雪降る空を見上げるふりをしながら…
lines.english: Outside my silent home, I pretended to gaze up at the snowy night sky…

lines.japanese: 俺はやっと、開き続けていた携帯を閉じる。
lines.english: And at last, I closed the phone I'd kept open all that time.

lines.japanese:
電車の中も、タクシーの中も、
ずっと無駄にライトを使い続けて、
とうとう電池が一目盛り減ってしまった。
lines.english: I'd kept its light burning uselessly through the whole train ride and the whole taxi ride, until finally the battery had lost a bar.

lines.japanese: 最低だな…
lines.english: I was the worst.

lines.japanese:
自分から動くことが許されないからって、
相手が動くことをずっと待ってるなんて、
最低の、最悪の、最底辺男だ…
lines.english: Telling myself I wasn't allowed to make a move, then waiting all that time for her to make one instead. The lowest, vilest kind of man there is…

lines.japanese: でもさ、和泉。
lines.english: But come on, Izumi.

lines.japanese:
お前、遠慮なく呼び出せって、
そう、言ってくれたじゃないか。
lines.english: You told me to call whenever I needed you, without holding back. You said so yourself.

lines.japanese:
こんなに辛いときにこそ、
こんなに寂しいときにこそ。
lines.english: Especially when it hurt this much. Especially when I was this lonely.

lines.japanese:
俺に、その脳天気な笑顔を見せてくれるのが、
お前の真骨頂なんじゃなかったのかよ？
lines.english: Wasn't this when you were supposed to show me that carefree grin of yours? Wasn't that what you did best?

lines.japanese:
この、馬鹿。
肝心なときに限って…使えねえ奴…っ
lines.english: You idiot. When it really matters… you're goddamn useless…

lines.japanese: 「お帰り～」
lines.english: “Welcome home!”
“What…?”

lines.japanese:
「メリー、クリスマス！
サンタのお姉さんがよい子のもとへやってきたよ～！」
lines.english: “Merry Christmas! Lady Santa has come to visit her good little boy!”

lines.japanese: 「…よい子に呼ばれたからやってきたよ～？」
lines.english: “…A good little boy called for me, so here I am?”

lines.japanese:
「やだな～、退かないでよ。
これバイト先から持ち出すの、
結構大変だったんだから～」
lines.english: “Aw, don't back away. It was a real pain sneaking this out of work, you know.”

lines.japanese:
「いや～、それにしても寒かった！
部屋かと思ったのに来てみたらいないんだもん」
lines.english: “Whew, that was cold! I thought you'd be home, but when I got here, you were gone.”

lines.japanese: 俺は、考えが甘かった。
lines.english: I should have known better.

lines.japanese:
「でも、やっぱ驚かすためには、
こっちからコールバックする訳にもいかなくてさ～」
lines.english: “But I couldn't very well call you back. That would've ruined the surprise.”

lines.japanese:
俺が、とうとう和泉を求めてしまった。
切羽詰まって、自分から連絡を取ってしまった。
lines.english: I had finally reached for Izumi. Desperate, I had contacted her myself.

lines.japanese:
「やっと帰ってきてくれて助かったよ～。
あと一時間遅かったら絶対マッチ三本すってたね、
あたし」
lines.english: “I’m glad you finally made it home. Another hour and I’d have been playing the Little Match Girl—three matches down, at least.”

lines.japanese:
そんな決定的瞬間を、
いつもいつもふざけてばかりのこいつが、
見逃すはずなんかない。
lines.english: Someone who never stopped fooling around was never going to let a moment like that pass her by.
“…Haruki?”

lines.japanese:
絶対に馬鹿やってくる。
俺を呆れさせるために、何でもやってくる。
lines.english: Of course she'd do something ridiculous. She'd do anything to make me roll my eyes.

lines.japanese: 俺の…求めに応じてくれる。
lines.english: She would answer… when I reached for her.

lines.japanese: 「春希ってば………っ！？」
lines.english: “Haruki, what are you—!?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿…っ！」
lines.english: “Idiot…!”
“…Whoa there.”

lines.japanese: 和泉の身体は冷え切っていた。
lines.english: Izumi's body was frozen through.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿野郎…」
lines.english: “You goddamn idiot…”
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
そして、冷え切っていたことが服越しにわかるくらい、
俺は、和泉に体を密着させていた。
lines.english: I had pressed myself against her so tightly that I could feel the cold of her body even through our clothes.

lines.japanese: 「あまりにも馬鹿すぎるだろ、お前」
lines.english: “How could you be this stupid?”

lines.japanese: 「春希…」
lines.english: “Haruki…”

lines.japanese: 和泉の苦しそうな吐息が耳にかかる。
lines.english: Izumi's strained breath brushed my ear.

lines.japanese:
「救いようがない馬鹿だ。
信じらんねぇ…っ」
lines.english: “You're a hopeless idiot. I can't believe you…!”

lines.japanese: 「そっか…」
lines.english: “I see…”

lines.japanese:
それでも俺は、力をゆるめることなんか
まるで考えられない。
lines.english: Even so, the thought of loosening my grip never entered my mind.
“Mm…”

lines.japanese:
和泉の冷たい頬を、無理やり俺の頬に擦りつけて、
柔らかさを感じながら、お互いの体温を交換する。
lines.english: I forced Izumi's cold cheek against mine and rubbed them together, feeling the soft skin and the heat passing between us.

lines.japanese: 「…っ…ぅぅ…っ」
lines.english: “Ngh… nnnh…!”

lines.japanese: 「んふふ…駄々っ子めぇ」
lines.english: “Heh… what a spoiled little brat.”

lines.japanese:
そんなふうに強引にしても、
和泉はやっぱり、ふざけて受け入れてしまう。
lines.english: Even when I handled her that roughly, Izumi still accepted it with a joke.

lines.japanese: 「ぅ…ぅぁ…ぁぁ…ぅぁぁ…っ」
lines.english: “Ngh… ah… aaah…!”

lines.japanese: 「ね、春希ぃ」
lines.english: “Hey, Haruki…”

lines.japanese:
ただ、抱きすくめられるだけじゃなく、
自分も腕を伸ばし、俺の背中を優しくさする。
lines.english: Rather than merely letting me hold her, she reached around me and gently stroked my back.

lines.japanese: 「ぃ…和泉ぃ…」
lines.english: “I-Izumi…”

lines.japanese: 「さ、落ち着きなって」
lines.english: “Come on. Settle down.”

lines.japanese:
しばらく背中をなで続けると、
今度は俺の肩に手を置き、
ゆっくりと腕を撫で下ろしていく。
lines.english: After rubbing my back for a while, she placed one hand on my shoulder and slowly stroked it down my arm.

lines.japanese: 「お…俺…っ」

「いい子にしてたら、
サンタさんがプレゼントあげるから、ね？」
lines.english: “Be a good boy and Santa will give you a present, okay?”

lines.japanese:
そして、自分の頭に巻きついた俺の腕を、
丁寧に、丁寧にほどいていく。
lines.english: Then, carefully—so carefully—she began disentangling the arm I had wound around her head.
“Ah…”

lines.japanese:
くっつきあってた頬を引き剥がされ、
和泉の顔が至近距離で俺の瞳に映る。
lines.english: Our cheeks came apart, and Izumi's face filled my vision from inches away.

lines.japanese: 「あぁ…」
lines.english: “Ah…”

lines.japanese: その、表情は…
lines.english: The look on her face was…

lines.japanese:
「ね？
だから、目を閉じ…っ！？」
lines.english: “See? So just close your eyes and—!?”

lines.japanese:
最初に見たときと同じ、
満面の笑顔、だった。
lines.english: the same beaming smile she had worn when I first saw her.

lines.japanese:
「ん、ん、ん…？
は、あむ…んぅっ！？」
lines.english: “Mm? Mmm… ah—mmph!?”

lines.japanese:
瞬間、俺の中で何かが弾け、
次に気がついたときには…
lines.english: In that instant, something burst inside me. And the next thing I knew…

lines.japanese: 「は、はる…ぅんっ、ん、む…んぅぅ」
lines.english: “H-Haru… mmm, mm… nnngh…”

lines.japanese:
いや…まだ自分が何をしてるか、
この時までは気づいていなかった。
lines.english: No… I hadn't even realized what I was doing until that moment.

lines.japanese:
ただ、視界が真っ白になったような気がして、
一度は抜けかけた力が、
ひきつけを起こしたように再び湧き上がり。
lines.english: My vision seemed to flare white, and the strength that had begun to drain from me came surging back in a spasm.

lines.japanese: 「ん～…あ、あむ…ちゅ…ん、んむ…は、ぁ」
lines.english: “Mmm… ah… mmph… ah…”

lines.japanese:
そしてじわじわと、
和泉の唇の温かさと柔らかさと滑らかさが、
俺の口の中に入り込んできて…
lines.english: Then, little by little, my mouth filled with the warmth and softness of Izumi's lips, the smooth glide of them…

lines.japanese: 「あ、ん～、はむぁ…あ、んぷ…は、ぁぁ…」
lines.english: “Ah… mmm… ahh…”

lines.japanese:
やっと、自分のしでかしたことの重大さに気づき、
和泉に何の断りもなく快感を貪っていた唇を引き離す。
lines.english: At last I understood the enormity of what I’d done and tore my lips from hers. I had taken that pleasure without ever asking Izumi’s permission.

lines.japanese: 「は～………はぁぁぁぁ」
lines.english: “Haaah… haaaah…”
“I-Izumi…?”

lines.japanese:
とんでもないことをしてしまったって背筋が凍りながらも、
その行為が、俺の凍てついていた心を
溶かし始めてたってことも全然否定できない。
lines.english: My spine went cold at the horror of what I'd done. And yet I couldn't deny that the same act had begun to thaw my frozen heart.

lines.japanese:
「む～…いきなり舌入れてくるなんて。
いけない子だね、春希」
lines.english: “Mmm… sticking your tongue in without warning? You've been a bad boy, Haruki.”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめ…」
lines.english: “I-I’m sor—”

lines.japanese:
「って、泣くな。
別に舌入れることが悪いなんて言ってないじゃん」
lines.english: “Hey, don't cry. I never said putting your tongue in was the bad part.”

lines.japanese:
俺をたしなめる和泉の声と言葉は、
やっぱりあくまでも優しくて、ふざけてた。
lines.english: Even as Izumi chided me, her voice and her words remained gentle, playful.

lines.japanese:
「ただ、単なる感想として
『いけない子だな～春希は』って思っただけだよ」
lines.english: “It was just an observation: ‘My, what a bad boy Haruki is.’ That's all.”

lines.japanese: 「それって…駄目じゃない、のか？」
lines.english: “Doesn't that mean… I shouldn't do it?”

lines.japanese:
「駄目な訳ないじゃん。
よい子でも、いけない子でも、
春希ならなんでもおっけ～だよ？」
lines.english: “Of course not. Good boy or bad boy, anything goes as long as it's you, Haruki.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ、心の準備だけさせて。
今から舌入れるぞとか、今から…入れるぞとか」
lines.english: “Just give me a little warning. Tell me before you put your tongue in, or before you… put something else in.”

lines.japanese: 「な…何を？」
lines.english: “P-put what in?”

lines.japanese:
「何だって。
あたしは、何されても嫌って言ったりしないから。
…春希にならね？」
lines.english: “Anything. I won't say no to anything you do to me. Not… if it's you, Haruki.”

lines.japanese:
ふざけ過ぎてて、少し現実離れしてて、
そして俺を全肯定する、麻薬のような甘さに満ちてた。
lines.english: Her words were flippant enough to feel unreal, and sweet as a drug in the unconditional acceptance they offered me.

lines.japanese:
「どする？
もっかい舌入れる？
…なら、あ～ん」
lines.english: “So? Want to put your tongue in again? Then… aaah.”

lines.japanese: 「ん…んむぅぅ…んく…ちゅぷ…はむぅっ…」
lines.english: “Mmm… nnnh… mmph…”

lines.japanese:
和泉の方から開けてくれた口腔の中に、
遠慮なく舌をねじ込んで、かき回す。
lines.english: I thrust my tongue deep into the mouth Izumi had opened for me and swept it through every corner without restraint.

lines.japanese:
和泉は、俺が無茶をしやすいように、
全身の力を抜いて、全てを受け入れてる。
lines.english: To make it easier for me to be reckless, Izumi let all the tension leave her body and gave herself over to everything I did.

lines.japanese:
「は、はる…ひぃ…は、あ、あむ…
ふぅぅ…ん、んむぁ…あんっ」
lines.english: “H-Haruki… ah… mmm… aaah…”

lines.japanese: 「ん…んむ…じゅぅ…ん、んく」
lines.english: “Mmm… nnnh…”

lines.japanese:
だから俺は、湧き上がってくる情欲そのままに、
和泉の歯に舌を這わせ、歯茎を舐め回し、
舌を絡めとり、音を立てて唾液を吸う。
lines.english: I gave myself over to the lust rising through me. My tongue traced Izumi's teeth, licked at her gums, caught and tangled with hers, and noisily sucked at the saliva between us.

lines.japanese:
「はっ、はぁっ…あ、あぁ…んんんっ！？
あ、ぷぁ…は、ぁぁ…ぁ…っ」
lines.english: “Hah… haaah… nnnh!? Ah… haaaah…!”

lines.japanese:
そんな、陶酔してしまいそうなほどの
熱さに身を委ねながら、
けれど、少しだけ湧き上がってくる違和感。
lines.english: I surrendered to a heat intoxicating enough to swallow me whole—and felt, beneath it, the faint stir of something wrong.

lines.japanese:
こうやって深く舌を絡ませてみて、
初めてわかったこと。
lines.english: Something I only discovered when I tangled my tongue this deeply with hers.

lines.japanese: 「んっ、んんっ…あ、あぷっ、ひっ…い、あ…ぁぁ…っ」
lines.english: “Mmm… ah… ngh… aaah…!”

lines.japanese: 「ん…ぷぁ…っ」
lines.english: “Mmm… ah…”

lines.japanese:
俺の、少ない経験の中だけで比べても…
つまり、雪菜と比べても全然慣れてない。
lines.english: Even with my own experience as limited as it was—with Setsuna as my only point of comparison—I could tell Izumi wasn't used to this at all.

lines.japanese:
「けほっ、こほっ…
は、はぁ、はぁ、はぁぁ…」
lines.english: “Cough… haaah, haaah, haaah…”
“…Izumi?”

lines.japanese:
あんなに誘うようなそぶりを見せておきながら…
こいつ、もしかして、あまり経験ない？
lines.english: After all those brazen invitations… could she actually have very little experience?

lines.japanese:
「ふ、ぅぁ、ぁぁぁ…
こ、このぉ………凄いじゃないかぁ」
lines.english: “Haaah… y-you… you're really something.”

lines.japanese:
「大丈夫…じゃないのか？
もしかして」
lines.english: “Are you… actually not okay?”

lines.japanese: それなのに俺、いきなり激しくしすぎた？
lines.english: Had I come at her far too hard, far too soon?

lines.japanese:
「いやぁ…
ちょっと心の準備が足りなかったな～、なんて。
己の思い上がりを痛感しちゃったかも？」
lines.english: “No, no… perhaps I was a little short on mental preparation. I've been made painfully aware of my own hubris.”

lines.japanese:
相変わらず茶化してくれる和泉だけど、
俺の両肩に載せた腕は重く、
頭を下げたまま、肩で息をしてる。
lines.english: Izumi was still making light of it, but her arms lay heavy on my shoulders, her head hung low, and her shoulders heaved with every breath.

lines.japanese:
「わ、悪いっ。
その、俺、我慢できなくて…」
lines.english: “S-sorry. I just… I couldn't hold myself back…”

lines.japanese:
あまりにも心地良すぎたから。
癒されすぎてしまったから。
lines.english: Because it had felt far too good. Because I'd found far too much comfort in her.

lines.japanese:
和泉が、全部受け止めてくれるって、
信じすぎてしまったから。
lines.english: Because I had trusted too blindly that Izumi would take everything I gave her.

lines.japanese: 「ね、春希」
lines.english: “Hey, Haruki.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「足、冷たくなってきた」
lines.english: “My legs are getting cold.”
“…Huh?”

lines.japanese:
でも、そんな被害者のはずの和泉は、
今度はミニスカートからはみ出た太股を、
寒そうにすり合わせる。
lines.english: Yet Izumi—the supposed victim in all this—only rubbed her bare thighs together against the cold.

lines.japanese:
それは、今まで俺に受けていた辱めを、
ちっとも咎めてるふうには見えなくて。
lines.english: Nothing in her manner suggested she meant to reproach me for what I'd just put her through.

lines.japanese:
それどころか、ため息を含んだかすれ声は、
俺を今以上に挑発する響きに満ちていた。
lines.english: If anything, her husky, sigh-laced voice only provoked me further.

lines.japanese: 「続き…中でしようよ？」
lines.english: “Let's continue… inside, okay?”

lines.japanese:
和泉にそう言われて、
迂闊にも初めて気がつく。
lines.english: Only when Izumi said it did the obvious finally dawn on me.

lines.japanese:
俺、まだ部屋に上がってなかったんだって。
それどころか、ここは道端なんだって。
lines.english: We hadn't even gone inside yet. Worse, we were standing in the street.

lines.japanese:
和泉を貪るのに夢中で、
自分が今どこにいるのかすら忘れてたって。
lines.english: I'd been so consumed with devouring Izumi that I'd forgotten where I was.

lines.japanese:
…自分が今まで何をしてきて、
どういう立場にいるのかすら忘れてたって。
lines.english: …And I'd forgotten everything I'd done up to then, even where that left me.
“The snow…?”

lines.japanese: 「やんだみたいだ」
lines.english: “Looks like it stopped.”

lines.japanese:
完全に寝静まった南末次の空は、
今度こそ、雲が大きく切れてきてた。
lines.english: Over sleeping Minami-Suetsugu, the clouds had finally begun to break in earnest.

lines.japanese:
記念すべきホワイトクリスマスは終わりを告げ、
後に残るは、黒く冷たい都会の生活に迷惑な雪。
lines.english: The white Christmas worth remembering was over. What remained was ordinary snow: a nuisance to life in the black, cold city.

lines.japanese:
そして、俺の中でも、
ずっと心の中を占めてた大きな何かが終わり、
新しい何かが始まりつつある…かもしれなかった。
lines.english: And inside me, too, something vast that had occupied my heart for so long was ending, and something new was beginning… perhaps.

lines.japanese: 「寒い？」
lines.english: “Cold?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「そか…んふ」
lines.english: “I see… heh.”

lines.japanese: 「っ…こ、こら」
lines.english: “H-hey, quit that.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、押すな～。
こっちギリギリなんだから」
lines.english: “Don't push! I'm already right at the edge.”

lines.japanese: 「下で寝ろ下で」
lines.english: “Sleep on the floor. Go on.”

lines.japanese:
だって、一人暮らし用の狭いベッドの中には、
窮屈そうに全身を絡ませあう、俺と和泉。
lines.english: There we were, Izumi and I, our whole bodies entwined in a bed barely wide enough for one.

lines.japanese:
友達だとか、単なる同じゼミの学生だとか、
レポートの面倒見てやっただけだとかの言い訳を、
綺麗さっぱりぶっ潰してしまったばかりの二人。
lines.english: Two people who had just demolished every excuse—that we were friends, that we merely shared a seminar, that I'd only helped her with a paper.

lines.japanese: 「離れたら寒いじゃん」
lines.english: “I'll get cold if I move away.”

lines.japanese: 「エアコンつければいいだろ」
lines.english: “Turn on the heat.”

lines.japanese: 「ＣＯ２排出削減～」
lines.english: “Reducing CO2 emissions.”

lines.japanese: 『さっきまでお互い吐きまくってただろＣＯ２』
lines.english: “We were both spewing CO2 nonstop a little while ago.”

lines.japanese:
「なら暴れるな。
大人しくもう寝ろ」
lines.english: “Then stop thrashing around. Lie still and go to sleep.”

lines.japanese:
…そんなネタ返しは、
和泉が思いっきり喜ぶだろうからしてやらない。
lines.english: …But Izumi would enjoy that comeback far too much, so I kept it to myself.

lines.japanese:
「そだね、寝よ寝よ。
すっごい疲れることやっちゃったし～」
lines.english: “Yeah, let's sleep. We did something seriously exhausting tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「…重い」
lines.english: “…You’re heavy.”

lines.japanese:
それだけじゃなく、足の温かさも、
お腹の柔らかさも、胸の、もっと凄い柔らかさも、
それに…その先でとんがってる先端の感触も。
lines.english: And not only that. The warmth of her legs, the softness of her stomach, the even more astonishing softness of her breasts… and the feel of the hard little tips jutting from them.

lines.japanese:
全部、俺の体にダイレクトに伝わってきて、
温かさだけじゃないものを、じわじわと俺に伝える。
lines.english: Every bit of it pressed directly against me, little by little stirring something that had nothing to do with warmth.

lines.japanese: 「春希は、どう？」
lines.english: “How about you, Haruki?”
“…How about me what?”

lines.japanese: 「疲れて、少しは楽になった？」
lines.english: “Now that you’ve worn yourself out, do you feel any better?”

lines.japanese:
和泉の言ってることは、
矛盾してるように聞こえるけど、
二人にとっては疑問を差し挟む余地なんかない。
lines.english: To anyone else, Izumi's question might have sounded contradictory. Neither of us needed to ask what she meant.

lines.japanese: 俺がどうして和泉に電話を掛けたのか…
lines.english: Why I had called Izumi…

lines.japanese:
なんで和泉に会ったその瞬間、
あんなとんでもない真似をしでかしたのか…
lines.english: Why I had done something so outrageous the instant I saw her…

lines.japanese: 「眠れそう？」
lines.english: “Think you can sleep?”

lines.japanese: 「…ああ」
lines.english: “…Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 和泉は全部、わかってるから。
lines.english: Because Izumi understood all of it.

lines.japanese: そして、全部受け止めてくれたから。
lines.english: And because she had accepted all of it.

lines.japanese: 「なんとか、眠れそうだ」
lines.english: “I think I'll manage.”

lines.japanese: 「あたしがいるからね」
lines.english: “Because I’m here.”
“…Maybe.”

lines.japanese: 「おやぁ～？」
lines.english: “Oho?”

lines.japanese: 「っ…さ、寝るぞ」
lines.english: “R-right. Time for bed.”

lines.japanese: 「おやおやぁ～？」
lines.english: “Oho-ho?”

lines.japanese:
「うるさいな…
さっきまで痛い痛い泣き叫んでたくせに」
lines.english: “Give it a rest. You were screaming ‘It hurts! It hurts!’ just a little while ago.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、その話蒸し返す？
あたしは全然構わないんだけど？」
lines.english: “Oh, we're bringing that up again? Fine by me.”

lines.japanese: 「………おやすみ！」
lines.english: “…Good night!”

lines.japanese: 「…ぷぷ」
lines.english: “Pfft…”

lines.japanese: 「ったく！」
lines.english: “Honestly!”

lines.japanese:
今度こそ、しつこい和泉に背中を向け、
窓から、だいぶ広がった星空を見上げる。
lines.english: This time I finally turned away from Izumi and her relentless teasing, and looked through the window at the stars spreading across the clearing sky.

lines.japanese: 「おやすみぃ、春希」
lines.english: “Good night, Haruki.”

lines.japanese:
和泉は、ごそごそと布団の中で動くと、
背中を向けた俺に、ぴとっと全身を密着させてきた。
lines.english: Izumi wriggled beneath the covers, then pressed her whole body snug against my back.

lines.japanese: 「暑苦しい」
lines.english: “You're smothering me.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、寒くないよね」
lines.english: “Right. You're not cold now, are you?”

lines.japanese:
俺は、そんな和泉に取り合わず、
強く目を閉じる。
lines.english: Ignoring her, I squeezed my eyes shut.

lines.japanese: …そう、目を閉じる。
lines.english: …Yes. I closed my eyes.

lines.japanese:
自分の罪を自覚して、
けれど、それでも闇を恐れずに目を閉じる。
lines.english: Aware of my sin, but unafraid of the dark, I closed my eyes all the same.

lines.japanese: 「寒くないよ、春希」
lines.english: “You're not cold, Haruki.”

lines.japanese: だって、だってさ…
lines.english: Because… because…

lines.japanese:
辛かったら、苦しかったら、
俺は、隣にある、この柔らかい身体を、
強く抱きしめればいいんだから。
lines.english: If it hurt, if I couldn't bear it, all I had to do was reach for the soft body beside me and hold it tight.

lines.japanese:
俺だけが、暗闇を抜けてしまった。
また、新しい罪を犯した。
lines.english: I alone had escaped the darkness. I had committed yet another new sin.

lines.japanese: …こんなに甘美で、あまりにも不公平な罪を。
lines.english: A sin so sweet, so terribly unfair.
